target_customer: Small and mid-sized employers in the Middle East and North Africa that need HR, payroll and recruiting in one system
problem: MENA companies run HR, payroll and hiring across disconnected tools, with local payroll and compliance rules that global suites handle poorly.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for ATS and HRIS, plus payroll, contractor payments and employer of record services
product_category: HR and recruiting platform with AI agents

founders.name: Akeed Azmi
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as previously Head of Growth, Expansion and Operations at Kitopi and Careem. Education not found.

founders.name: David Reche
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as previously VP of Product and Engineering at Kingmakers and a product and engineering leader at Careem. Education not found.

competitors.name: ZenHR
competitors.what: HR and payroll platform for Saudi Arabia, UAE, Jordan, Egypt and other Arab markets

competitors.name: Bayzat
competitors.what: UAE based HR, payroll and benefits platform serving UAE and Saudi Arabia
competitors.funding_then: a 16M USD Series B is reported, date not shown in the snippet

technical_complexity.rationale: HRIS and payroll are standard software but need local payroll and compliance rules per country, which is slow work for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Payroll and employee records create switching costs once adopted, but at founding the product was young and rivals were established.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found. Regional rivals kept operating and Cercli raised a Series A in October 2025.

market_need_then: MENA SMEs were moving off spreadsheets and global suites. Regional press framed the company as a Rippling for MENA, and a regional HR software market was estimated at 5.8B USD in company press.

identity.mascot_or_character: Named AI agents Orin, Cera and Sila shown on the website
identity.visual_style: orbit graphics, per the website text
identity.voice_and_tone: friendly and informal, playful copy about AI agents that clock in

branding.brand_signature: Named AI agents on the product site

brand_strength.rationale: Brand search found no press about the brand itself, only product and funding coverage.

outcome_analysis: Cercli is active and raised a 4M seed in September 2024 and a 12M Series A in October 2025. Founders with Careem and Kitopi operating experience and a regional gap in AI era HR software explain the traction, though the Series A was post batch and the company remains early against established regional rivals.
notes: CB Insights lists 16.5M total over 4 rounds, so other small rounds such as YC may exist. Outcome search found no acquisition or layoffs.
